dictionary.repository-read: Read repository files, git history, .uproject, config, and text inspection of content.
dictionary.durable-state-write: Write to agent_collab/state/, handoffs/, outbox/, logs/ (Orchestrator only).
dictionary.structured-output: Emit and consume JSON matching defined schemas.
dictionary.runtime-invocation: Invoke other runtimes/agents via the Invoke-AgentRuntime mechanism.
dictionary.git-worktree-management: Create, use, and clean up isolated git worktrees for tasks.
dictionary.git-candidate-integration: Merge task branches into candidate branches and manage promotion.
dictionary.lease-management: Acquire, renew, release, and validate exclusive Orchestrator leases.
dictionary.policy-enforcement: Enforce scope, command, autonomy, and content policies.
dictionary.state-reconciliation: Reconcile state caches against Git, handoffs, outbox, branches, worktrees, and generated files.
dictionary.text-file-editing: Modify project-owned text files inside assigned coder_edit_roots.
dictionary.ue5-cpp: Work with C++ source under Source/.
dictionary.ue5-editor-automation: Create or invoke editor automation that generates/configures content.
dictionary.ue5-pcg-integration: Work with PCG graphs and subsystems (text sources).
dictionary.asset-pack-analysis: Analyze (read-only) asset pack structure and compatibility.
dictionary.generated-content-production: Produce binary outputs via approved automation inside assigned generated_output_ownership.
dictionary.map-load-validation: Verify generated maps load correctly (evidence capture).
dictionary.automation-testing: Run or review UE automation tests.
dictionary.package-smoke-testing: Perform packaging and launch smoke verification.
dictionary.human-playtest: Capture structured human playtest feedback (human-only capability).
dictionary.human-playtest-recording: Persist human playtest results to outbox/playtest/ (Orchestrator only).
dictionary.planning: Produce dependency DAGs with ownership, verification, and runtime constraints.
dictionary.external-research: Investigate external docs, APIs, packs, conventions (read-only).
dictionary.scope_audit: Audit adherence to file and generated output ownership.
dictionary.integration_verification: Audit candidate branches and required verification profiles.

notes: Capabilities are used for role requirements (roles.json), runtime declarations (runtimes.json), and runtime-to-role validation (adapter_matrix.json).
